title: AgentHeadByRefResponse
description: Response of GET /api/v1/best-configs/agent-heads/by-ref/{agent_ref}?environment=<SessionEnvironment>: the promotion head generation of the agent the Backend-issued `agent_ref` stands for, in the caller's tenant and project. Closed: it carries the ref, the closed environment, the generation and whether the agent was ever promoted there; never a raw agent id, name, best-config id or run id. INVARIANTS (enforced by the oneOf below): `exists` is false if and only if `generation` is 0, and true if and only if `generation` >= 1. TRANSITIONS: the first promotion takes the head 0 -> 1, a later one g -> g+1, atomically with the publication of the configuration version; of several promotions that name the same expected generation exactly one wins, every other one is refused as stale and changes nothing. Read-route refusals use best_config_head_refusal_schema.json and echo nothing; precedence: authentication and permissions, then a malformed path ref or `environment` (400 head_capture_invalid), then an unknown or foreign ref (404 reference_not_found).

agent_ref.description: The ref that was asked about, returned unchanged (it is a Backend-issued opaque value the caller already holds).

generation.description: Current head generation; the value a run captures when it STARTS and sends back as X-Traigent-Expected-Head-Generation when it publishes its own result. It is not a token to refresh and reuse for a result computed against an older head (see head_generation_stale). JSON-safe integer bound.

exists.description: True when the agent was promoted at least once in this environment (generation >= 1); false means generation 0.
